title: Stacks
subtitle: Keep only unfinished work: LIFO order exposes the most recent unresolved context or nearest useful candidate.
variables: n = input elements/tokens, h = stack height, d = nesting depth, V/E = reachable graph vertices/edges, R = expanded output length. Costs assume constant-time primitive comparison/arithmetic on bounded-size values; Python big-integer operations add bit costs. list append is amortized O(1); a resize can be O(h). List end pop is amortized O(1), including occasional shrinking. Auxiliary space excludes returned output unless specified; iterative stacks count as auxiliary just as recursion frames do. Hash-set graph bounds are expected. All templates are Python 3.10+ standard library and avoid recursion-depth dependence. u = distinct symbols, n = total online calls for span analysis. Binary-tree h denotes tree height; explicit frames do not automatically imply O(h) for arbitrary-degree trees. Added examples count negation copies, returned slices and matrix-height state. Operation table costs describe the named operation on preexisting state; executable examples also construct small fixtures and verify results, whose setup/assertion cost is not the operation cost.

contrasts: Stack vs queue
LIFO explores latest pending work; FIFO processes earliest and gives BFS layers.
Monotonic stack vs deque
Stack resolves nearest boundaries; deque supports moving-window expiry and extrema.
Indices vs values
Indices retain widths, distances and duplicate identity; values suffice for pure cancellation/evaluation.
Strict vs nonstrict pop
< resolves strict next-greater; >= removes equal blockers for previous strictly smaller. Tie rules depend on the question.
Amortized vs worst per call
A full scan can be O(n) although one item pops O(n) predecessors; a streaming next() call may be linear individually.
Recursive vs explicit frames
Both store pending work; explicit frames avoid interpreter recursion depth but not memory requirements.
Histogram area vs minimum contribution
Area maximizes height times one maximal width; contribution sums value times number of owning subarrays.
Substring vs subsequence
Boundary-index parentheses finds a contiguous segment; greedy deletions retain a subsequence and may skip positions.
Node frontier vs recursive DFS frames
Mark-on-push LIFO gives reachability but can schedule cross-edge siblings too early to match recursive DFS. Suspend neighbor iterators for exact semantics.
Histogram vs rain water
Histogram uses limiting bar height; water uses minimum of two walls minus basin bottom.

Returns exact sum by default, negatives supported, empty 0, no mutation. sum_subarray_ranges variation uses max(a)=-min(-a): O(n) time/O(n) auxiliary including negated copy; empty 0, no mutation.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Each subarray assigns its minimum to exactly one chosen occurrence. Adaptation: Executable ranges variation uses max=-min(-values), including allocation.

templateDetails.preconditions: String, integer k>0; repeatedly cancels adjacent groups of exactly k as a deterministic left-to-right reduction including cascades. Does not alter input; empty string remains empty.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Stack expands to the fully reduced processed prefix. Adaptation: k=2 removes ordinary pairs; k=1 deletes all.

templateDetails.preconditions: ASCII nonnegative decimal string (empty allowed as zero), integer 0<=k<=length. Delete exactly k positions preserving relative order, normalize leading zeroes; no mutation.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Retained prefix is lexicographically minimal under the remaining deletion/completion budget. Adaptation: Digit version allows repeats; distinct version cannot lose final copy.

templateDetails.preconditions: Reusable finite sequence of nonzero signed integers; sign gives direction, magnitude size; positions ordered left to right, all speeds equal. Larger survives, equal annihilate. Returns new survivor list; no mutation.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Survivor stack is collision-free for the processed prefix. Adaptation: Equal speed essential; different velocities need timing.

templateDetails.preconditions: String of only parentheses; length of longest contiguous balanced substring, not subsequence. Empty 0, no mutation; invalid character ValueError.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Bottom stores last invalid boundary; other indices are unmatched opens. Adaptation: Not a subsequence problem; boundary positions matter.

templateDetails.preconditions: Grammar: ASCII letters, concatenation and positive-integer[expression] nesting; empty expression/text allowed, no bare digits. Iterative, no recursion; returns expanded string, invalid syntax ValueError. R is final expanded length, d maximum depth; nested joining may rematerialize output O(dR). No expansion cap: use only within trusted output constraints. The O(n+dR) bound counts character copies and bounded-word count operations; very long decimal counts additionally incur Python arbitrary-precision integer parsing/arithmetic cost, even when repeating an empty fragment.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Frames store suspended outer contexts and current frame holds decoded inner prefix. Adaptation: Trusted output constraints required; iterative nested joins still cost O(n+dR).

templateDetails.preconditions: Mapping hashable vertices to reversible ordered neighbor sequences, directed or undirected unweighted graph. Visits vertices reachable from start once, missing key treated as leaf; returns [start] when absent. No mutation; deterministic stack traversal, not guaranteed identical to recursive DFS preorder because siblings are marked on push. For exact recursive semantics use iterator frames.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Each scheduled vertex is marked once; iterator frames retain one active neighbor cursor per DFS ancestor. Adaptation: Node-frontier mark-on-push can differ on cross edges; iterator frames reproduce recursive order.

templateDetails.preconditions: Comparable prices; next mutates state and returns consecutive days ending today with price<=today. Equal prices merge. One call may pop O(n), but each group is pushed/popped once across calls.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Groups partition processed days; group prices are strictly decreasing. Adaptation: One call O(n), lifetime O(n); equality merges.

templateDetails.preconditions: String ordered by Python code points; lexicographically minimum subsequence with each distinct symbol once. Empty empty, no mutation. Pop only when another copy remains.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Retained prefix is lexicographically minimal under the remaining deletion/completion budget. Adaptation: Digit version allows repeats; distinct version cannot lose final copy.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite proper binary tree, no cycles/shared descendants; left-right-node values, empty [], no mutation. h is height; frames hold ancestors plus bounded pending siblings. Arbitrary-degree push-all may require O(n) frames.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Each exit frame resumes exactly the deferred work after its children. Adaptation: Binary-tree frames O(h); arbitrary degree push-all may need O(V); graphs need visited.

templateDetails.preconditions: ASCII nonnegative integer literals, whitespace, binary +/-, parentheses and unary +/- (repeated unary signs accepted). Nonempty expression required; invalid syntax ValueError. No multiplication/division or implicit multiplication, no eval or mutation; Python big-integer parsing/arithmetic add bit costs.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Frames encode outer totals and multipliers for unfinished expressions. Adaptation: Only +/-; multiplication needs precedence parser, never eval.

templateDetails.preconditions: Directed/undirected adjacency mapping of hashable vertices to finite stable ordered iterables. Iterator frames reproduce recursive DFS neighbor order, no recursion or graph mutation. Missing start is a leaf; cycles use seen. Private frame-list sentinel cannot be a hashable vertex. h is DFS depth.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Each scheduled vertex is marked once; iterator frames retain one active neighbor cursor per DFS ancestor. Adaptation: Node-frontier mark-on-push can differ on cross edges; iterator frames reproduce recursive order.

templateDetails.preconditions: Reusable indexable finite nonnegative numeric unit-width heights; trapped area, empty 0, no mutation. Resolves horizontal layers between two taller walls. Two-pointer alternative uses O(1) auxiliary memory.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Resolved layers have valid walls and are counted once above popped bottoms. Adaptation: Two pointers uses O(1) auxiliary; variable widths need width-prefix sums.

decisionProcess: 0–20 seconds: Identify latest unfinished context, nearest useful neighbor or explicit continuation. Clarify comparison strictness, output order and input grammar.
20–45 seconds: Matching/evaluation stack for nesting; monotonic indices for boundaries; metadata for prefix min; run stack for reductions; iterator/exit frames for recursion replacement.
45–80 seconds: Describe stack contents and what pop means (resolve, dominate, cancel or return). Choose equal-value ownership before implementation.
80–120 seconds: Derive answer from indices/boundaries and prove each item enters/leaves once. Include hidden allocations, hash assumptions, integer bit costs and expanded output.

120–180 seconds: Trace empty/underflow/equal/increasing/decreasing input, negative division and unfinished contexts. Compare queue for BFS, deque for expiring windows, two pointers for water-space optimization.

practiceDetails.insight: Unmatched opener order detects crossing. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(d), and expose: Crossed nesting and leftover openers.
Prefix minimum at every height handles pops. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(1) amortized updates; O(h), and expose: Duplicate minima.
Deletion can expose another cancellable pair. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Cascades after deletion.
History operations require correct stack arity. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Operations read prior scores with correct arity.
Right operand pops first. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n) bounded-word ops; O(n), and expose: Right operand first, truncate toward zero.
Unique values permit value-to-answer lookup. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n+m) expected; O(n), and expose: Problem uniqueness permits value->answer map.
Resolve colder indices; distance is i-j. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Equal temperature is not warmer.
Only original indices need pushing. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Scan twice but push once.
Absorb spans of all no-greater groups. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n) total for n calls; O(n), and expose: One next() may pop many spans.
Only inward-facing survivors interact. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Only inward-facing pair interacts.
Run counts survive cascades. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Retain prior run count after cascading pop.
Nested output may rematerialize per depth. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n+dR) conservative; O(n+R), and expose: Output expansion and nested joins.
Discard larger leaders while budget remains. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Leftover budget and leading zeros.
Pop only if another copy remains. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(u), and expose: Pop only if symbol appears later.
Push right before left for left-first preorder. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(h) tree auxiliary, and expose: Push right before left.
Emit exit only after both children. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(h) for binary-tree frames, and expose: Emit after children, not on entry.
Popped height spans exclusive nearest boundaries. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Exclusive boundary width and sentinel flush.
Zero resets height; run histogram per row. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(rows*cols); O(cols), and expose: Reset height on zero cells.
Asymmetric ties assign every minimum once. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Asymmetric tie ownership.
Ranges equal maxima minus minima. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Separate strictness choices for minima/maxima.
Invalid closing index becomes new base. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(n), and expose: Reset base after unmatched close.
Minus negates the whole inner context. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n); O(d), and expose: Unary minus and parenthesized sign context.

Each bottom resolves a horizontal water layer. Mastery: reconstruct invariant and code unaided, justify O(n) time; O(n) stack or O(1) two-pointer auxiliary, and expose: Need two walls and bounded height difference, not histogram area.
